svg.title: Exact-copy probability and sequence length
svg.desc: For independent copying, Q equals q to the L. At length 100, q 0.99 gives 37 percent exact copies and q 0.999 gives 90 percent. At length 1000, the same probabilities are 0.0043 percent and 37 percent. This is a model, not experimental data.

g.text: Small error rates accumulate across a sequence
Independent positions: Q = qᴸ. Exact copies only; mutations need not destroy function.
